evidence: Changes src/script/sign.cpp to correct PSBT MuSig2 key and derivation path population, directly affecting wallet PSBT handling and descriptor processing.
rationale: Fixes an issue where the signer assumed all MuSig2 entries in a SigningProvider applied to the input being signed, leaking unrelated participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into inputs and outputs where they do not belong (issue #36323). Fixing this metadata leakage is an important correctness and privacy improvement in PSBT handling.
